title: fix: derive request.port from request.host
prompt:
This restores `request.port` to use the same effective host source as `request.host`.

`#6603` fixed port parsing, but it also changed `request.port` to read directly from `request.headers.host` / `:authority`. When `trustProxy` is enabled, `request.host` may come from `x-forwarded-host`, so `request.host`, `request.hostname`, and `request.port` could disagree.

This patch keeps the parsing logic from `#6603`, but parses from `request.host` so the three properties stay aligned again.

It also adds coverage for the trust-proxy cases discussed in `#6671`, including `:authority` fallback.

Refs: #6671
Closes
